demo.demo_note: stdlib smoke — deterministic LCG, not saved as real embedding, for manifest verification only

rope.applied_to: TCA Q/K per type (32-d/h), TAA Q/K shared 128-d (4 heads ×32)
rope.pos_encoding: season idx / node idx, most recent season for TAA neighbor sampling

swiglu.formula: SwiGLU(x) = (SiLU(W1 x) * (W2 x)) W3, W1,W2 in R^(d->256), W3 in R^(256->d)
swiglu.formula_detail: SiLU(x)=x*sigmoid(x), gated = SiLU(xW1) * (xW2), out = gated W3
swiglu.params_est: ~ 2*d*256 + 256*d per SwiGLU block, d=64 base, 224/128 for TCA/TAA

tca.params_detail: 70% of GraphBFF dual params — 7× Q/K/V 32-d per type, RoPE 32-d/h, RMSNorm, SwiGLU 256
tca.sparsity_detail: for each node, keep top 40% attention scores per type, mask others to -inf, then softmax
tca.qkv: Q/K/V 32-d per type, RoPE 32-d/h freq 10000**-2i/32, shared across batch
tca.batching: KL64 representative + RR32/type = 224 edges total per batch

taa.sampling: 8 most recent season, same state for schools, cap neighbor list 8
taa.sampling_detail: for each node, sample 8 neighbors sorted by season desc, same state if schools, LCG deterministic shuffle within top 2k, ensure most recent included
taa.params_detail: 30% of GraphBFF dual params — 1 head shared QKV 128-d, RoPE 32-d/h projected to 128-d (4 heads ×32)
taa.qkv: shared QKV 128-d, deterministic LCG init seed 17/19/23
taa.temporal: 2L season trajectory — early vs late season same-player (hoops/gridiron TAA twin)

fusion.projection: 224+128 -> 64 via SwiGLU 256 gated + RMSNorm ε1e-06 + L2 + max_abs clamp 0.90783
fusion.ensure: max_abs ≤0.90783 post-L2 by iterative clip+renorm (2 steps) — ensures diffuse sphere, not one-hot
fusion.formula: fused = 0.7*proj_TCA(224->64) + 0.3*proj_TAA(128->64), RMSNorm, L2, clip max_abs 0.90783, renorm

graphbff.batch_detail: KL64 team+era clusters representative nodes + RR32/type×7=224 edges random relational per type

vicreg.formula: VICReg = w*(var_coef*var_loss + cov_coef*cov_loss), var_loss=hinge(1-std), cov_loss=off-diag cov^2

supcon.detail: SupCon τ0.07 w0.15 — supervised contrastive over archetype/team
supcon.formula: SupCon = -log(exp(z·z+/τ)/Σ exp(z·z_j/τ)) mean over positives same label

batching.batch_detail: batch 512 — KL64 + RR32/type 224 edges, total 288 nodes representative+relational per batch
